notes.text: The supplied name is לוי and locator ר״ה כט:, expanded as Rosh Hashanah 29b. Earlier machine OCR gave לי and ר״ה כטא; these are not newly verified printed variants. The notice ends with a comma, preserved here. The abbreviated personal title remains R'.
